candidate_relations.reason: Although tuberculosis could cause pulmonary and CNS disease in an immunocompromised patient, the benchmark diagnosis specifically requires disseminated Rhodococcus equi infection with necrotizing pneumonia, bacteremia, and brain abscess; C001 instead asserts Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different disseminated infection and etiology from the required Rhodococcus equi pneumonia, bacteremia, and brain abscess composite.
